text:
sam: quick heads-up — i'm prototyping a 'unit-econ matrix' card for the console. goal: show per-invocation breakdown (model tokens, kv-cache hits, routing overhead, and a small amortized infra line). want to lock telemetry keys before i wire the frontend so we don't have schema drift

anika: love the idea. do we plan to surface both raw tokens and normalized cost? users ask for both in billing calls

liam: i vote for normalized cost + a toggle to view raw token counts. for telemetry keys, +1 for: route_id, model_sku, model_version, cache_hit(bool), token_in, token_out, gpu_ms, region

sam: agreed. draft payload i'm thinking:
```json
{"route_id":"string","model_sku":"string","model_version":"string","cache_hit":true,"tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":128,"gpu_ms":12.4,"sample_rate":0.01,"timestamp":1709876543}
```
this keeps the event small and backfillable

gina: two Qs — (1) how do we attribute shared prefetch cache savings? (2) sample_rate: how to surface in UI so cost estimates look right for end users

prateek: for (1) i'd prefer an amortization tag on the prefetch event: prefetch_owner and prefetch_window_seconds. UI can show a "prefetch credit" line that is applied proportionally by route weight. for (2) expose sample_rate in the card tooltip and compute inverse-scaling when sample_rate < 1

liam: small API debate: do we emit these events from the router (single place) or from the serving runtime? router has route_id easily, runtime has exact gpu_ms and cache_hit accuracy. can we emit a combined event with router augment?

sam: my preference: runtime emits detailed event, router emits a lightweight route-enrichment event that downstream joiner (billing pipeline) merges. avoids double counting and keeps deployment decoupled.

anika: sounds good. pipeline needs a stable join key — propose `request_id` (uuid) present in both events. router adds it if missing.

prateek: agreed. also add `cost_model_version` field to event so we can iterate on pricing math without re-ingesting raw telemetry

gina: UX ask — the card should let PMs simulate routing swaps: show "if 10% routed to model-x-quant, estimated saving = $Y/day". that requires synthetic what-if calc but only on aggregated metrics

sam: implement plan: 1) telemetry schema PR (runtime + router) 2) pipeline joiner + sample-rate-aware aggregations 3) frontend card + simulate slider. i'll open the schema PR and assign liam/prateek to review.

rollout-bot: canary deploy scheduled for telemetry-evt-v1 on 1709876600 :rocket:

sam: thanks — i'll link the PR in #eng-platform when it's up. tagging @anika for UX review later.
